Row.Text: "Wealth circulates like blood, all parts partake."
"I take refuge in the Buddha. I take refuge in the Dharma. I take refuge in the Sangha."
"Plentie of money maketh generally things deare, and scarcity of money maketh likewise generally things good cheape."
"I have collected all the writings and burnt those which were of no use."
"Colonialism is not satisfied merely with holding a people in its grip, but it turns to the past of the oppressed people, and destroys it."
"A bureaucracy always tends to become a pedantocracy."
"Since words are not fine, fine words are not sincere."
"The social pact ensures that men become equal by covenant and by right."
"Every empire tells itself that its mission is not to plunder and control but to educate and liberate."
"The spear and the title go together."
"When monks are righteous, rajahs are righteous. When ministers are righteous, brahmins and householders are righteous. Thus townsfolk and villagers are righteous."
"By knowing things in their true nature, one knows the divine."
"The gospel cannot be truly preached without offense and tumult."
